name: Wallaby Spotter Clive

intro.text: I've had binoculars on this moor for twenty years. Twenty years! Saw a wallaby once. Might have been a bin bag. Battle me!

win: Beaten by someone who's been here ten minutes. Typical.
after: If you see a wallaby, tell the Watcher by Rockhall. Not me. I'll only cry.
